test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Union ministries presented a special festival series titled ‘Amrit Parampara’ in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Culture** is responsible for the preservation and promotion of art and culture in India.
 
• The special festival series titled '**Amrit Parampara**' was presented to celebrate and promote India's rich cultural heritage.
 
• This initiative is part of the larger celebrations of India's 75th year of independence, known as '**Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav**'.
 
• The festival series aims to showcase various traditional and contemporary art forms, including **music, dance, theatre, and visual arts**.
 
• The **Ministry of Culture** collaborates with various cultural organizations, artists, and institutions to organize such events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Tourism**__

 __
 
• The **Ministry of Tourism** is responsible for the promotion of tourism in India.
 
• It works on policies and strategies to attract tourists and develop tourism infrastructure.
 
• The ministry also promotes India as a destination for **foreign tourists** and domestic travelers.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of External Affairs**__
 __
 
• The **Ministry of External Affairs** handles India's foreign relations and international diplomacy.
 
• It oversees bilateral and multilateral relations with other countries and international organizations.
 
• This ministry is also responsible for the welfare of **Indian citizens abroad**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Textiles**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Textiles** is responsible for the development and promotion of the textile industry in India.
 
• It formulates policies and programs to enhance the competitiveness of the textile sector.
 
• The ministry also supports the growth of **handlooms, handicrafts, and sericulture**.
